purpose: Identify behavioural characteristics at strategy signal time and during the subsequent price path that distinguish positive, flat and negative strategy markets.

methodology.marketClassification: positive if netProfit > 0; flat if netProfit === 0; negative if netProfit < 0
methodology.positionStrategy: Existing strategy results are used only to classify each market. This runner does not alter capacity selection or strategy thresholds.
methodology.signalPopulation: All qualifying strategy signals in the existing candle datasets are analysed.
methodology.forwardReturnDefinition: close-to-close percentage return from the signal candle close to the close at the requested future horizon.
methodology.mfeDefinition: maximum future candle high relative to the signal candle close within the requested horizon.
methodology.maeDefinition: minimum future candle low relative to the signal candle close within the requested horizon.
methodology.timeToTargetDefinition: First future candle whose high reaches the target price.
methodology.timeToStopDefinition: First future candle whose low reaches the -10% stop price.
methodology.trendPersistenceDefinition: Fraction of recent one-minute returns that are positive.
methodology.reversalRateDefinition: Direction changes between consecutive non-zero one-minute returns divided by the number of possible transitions.
methodology.efficiencyDefinition: Absolute net price movement divided by the sum of absolute one-minute movements over the lookback window.
methodology.volatilityDefinition: Standard deviation of one-minute logarithmic returns over the lookback window.
methodology.normalisation: Regression slope divided by the signal candle close price.
methodology.leakage: No future candles are used to construct entry indicators. Forward measurements are only used diagnostically after the signal.
methodology.optimisation: None. This is a diagnostic experiment, not a threshold-selection experiment.
